entities.name: Karl II, Grand Duke of Mecklenburg-Strelitz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles II was ruler of the state of Mecklenburg-Strelitz from 1794 until his death. Originally ruling as duke, he was raised to the rank of grand duke in 1815. Prior to succeeding to the throne, he served as Governor of Hanover from 1776 to 1786.
